description: This file contains the implementation of the AzureQueueAdapterReceiver class, which manages receiving and processing message batches from an Azure Storage Queue within the Orleans streaming framework. It handles queue initialization, message retrieval, and message delivery acknowledgment, including message deletion from the queue after processing.

classes.name: AzureQueueAdapterReceiver
classes.description: Implements the IQueueAdapterReceiver interface to receive message batches from an Azure Storage Queue, manage their lifecycle, and handle message acknowledgments within Orleans streaming.

classes.name: PendingDelivery
classes.description: Represents a pending message delivery, associating a message's sequence token with the corresponding queue message.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate an AzureQueueAdapterReceiver with provided configuration and dependencies.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the queue, preparing it for message retrieval.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the receiver, ensuring pending operations are completed.

methods.name: GetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of messages from the queue, converting them into IBatchContainer instances.

methods.name: MessagesDeliveredAsync
methods.description: Acknowledges message delivery and deletes the corresponding messages from the queue.

methods.name: LogWarningOnDeleteQueueMessage
methods.description: Logs a warning if an exception occurs during message deletion.
